content.text: {"name":"Flow-rate spread conditioned on common index regime","hypothesis":"Groups with a higher separation rate (V03) relative to a hiring-type rate (V02) after cross-sectional standardization have weaker labor conditions, so in the high regime of T this spread predicts lower next-month returns; the sign is negative.","falsified_if":"Mean cross-sectional IC of this feature in the high-T regime is zero or positive in development statistics.","expression":"regime(spread(V03,V02),\"high\")"}
